description: This file implements classes and functions related to touchpad configuration management within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It defines concrete classes for handling touchpad configs and flags, and provides component functions for dependency injection setup.

classes.name: TouchpadsConfigsImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the TouchpadsConfigs interface, managing a list of touchpad configurations.

classes.name: TouchpadsConfigsFlagImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the TouchpadsConfigsFlag interface, handling flag processing and configuration setup.

methods.name: GetConfigs
methods.description: Returns the current list of touchpad configurations.

methods.name: SetConfigs
methods.description: Sets the list of touchpad configurations.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the configuration implementation.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments to update touchpad configurations.

methods.name: WriteGflagsCompatHelpXml
methods.description: Outputs help information for the touchpad flag in XML format.
